## Abstract

Smore-008 flew u4b_008 (channel 122) under a single CyMylar 60 balloon — the first flight on this balloon type, chosen for its much higher predicted float altitude compared to the 32in latex balloons used on earlier launches. The tracker was ground-tested beforehand and decoded cleanly. Wind on launch day was higher than ideal, so launch was timed for a calm lull. No telemetry was received after launch; antenna damage during the launch release is the leading theory.
